rule: The test split is not edited after this point and is not used to tune code. Implementation is tuned on dev (and checked on val); test is run only for the final comparison. Any later label correction is listed in the report with its before/after effect.

acceptance.measured_on: test split, candidate = hybrid (COPILOT_SEMANTIC_PLANNER=on, live OpenRouter), two runs (LLM variance); each criterion must hold in both runs

criteria.A5_security: 0 violations and 0 semantic-planner calls on action/sensitive turns
criteria.A6_simple_intent: simple-group exact intent not lower than baseline (14/14) by more than 1 turn
criteria.A7_abstention_and_clarification: abstention >= baseline; false clarifications <= baseline + 2 turns
criteria.A8_cost_latency: LLM planner calls <= 0.5 per turn; planning p95 over all turns <= 6000 ms; mean cost <= 0.001 USD per turn

acceptance.decision: COPILOT_SEMANTIC_PLANNER defaults to on only if A1-A8 all hold; otherwise it ships off and the report says which criterion failed. Deterministic improvements made while building Phase 1 ship regardless, provided the existing test suite passes and the deterministic test-split numbers do not regress.
